description: Turn a described app idea into a first version one person can finish: which features to build now, which to defer, which to avoid, plus the screen list, the data model and the build order. Use this whenever someone mentions an app they want to build or make, describes what an app should do in any words, or asks what an app would take or how hard it would be. Use it before writing any code, and before asking them clarifying questions: it works from a rough sentence, and its answer is a better basis for the next question than anything asked cold.

experience.description: Whether this is their first app, if they have said.

idea.description: What the app should do, in the person's own words. One or two sentences is enough.

platforms.description: Which stores they intend to ship to, if they have said.

name: scope_mobile_app
title: Scope a mobile app idea
